title: Ordered AddToSet mutation and OnSpeederBike vehicle predicate

conditions.name: AddToSet
conditions.scope: First-call gated and self creature/reference/actor guarded. Whole case-insensitive Reset sets actor byte+0x378=0 without count decrement. Other operands use original packet numeric resolver, truncate float32 toward zero, and accept only1..16. Each accepted token assigns actor byte+0x378 and increments global byte0x876847+index modulo256. Repeated memberships and reassignments increment independently without correcting previous counts.
conditions.numericContract: Finite float32 within int32 conversion range. Existing MessageNumbers.Resolve supplies packet parameter0 for any case-insensitive param substring, first matching named parameter among4, otherwise decimal-prefix parser. Final native division explicitly stores/reloads float32 before integer conversion.

conditions.name: OnSpeederBike
conditions.scope: Initializer gates operand,system and callback, extracts named-reference first pointer. Reader uses initialized actor if nonnull, otherwise dereferences unchecked script-creature+0xd0 and guards its reference/actor. Requires actor link+0xcd0, actor byte context+0x7b5==0x3b and linked object word+0x1064 equal runtime global word0x7f1948. Missing name falls back to self; null creature with null initialized actor faults native.

assemblyFindings.detail: Reset branch stores AL=0 directly into actor+0x378; it does not update any global count.
add byte ptr[eax+0x876847],1 for every accepted numeric token; no old-membership comparison or decrement.

Final decimal division is stored with fstp dword[esp+0xc], then reloaded at0x4f2997. AddToSet integer conversion therefore sees stored binary32; existing MessageNumbers.Resolve composition is appropriate for bounded numeric inputs.
Fallback reads [eax+0xd0] without null-checking the creature argument; initialized actor bypasses this read.
cmp cx,word ptr[0x7f1948] uses the runtime word global, not an assumed constant vehicle ID. The retained analysis image starts with-1; host initialization is external.

Retained operand0.99999994 rounds natively tofloat1 because decimal numerator accumulation stores each multiply/add tofloat32; AddToSet therefore chooses1. Host float.parse of original text is not the parser contract.
